Reclaimer.notes: Best for large wrecks and bulk RMC collection. Requires a crew.

Vulture.notes: Ideal for solo operators. Efficient for small wrecks and component salvage.

Yela Asteroid Belt.notes: High wreck density from player combat. Good RMC yields.

Delamar.notes: Derelict outposts near Levski. Good for solo Vulture runs.

CRU-L4 Ship Graveyard.notes: Designated wreck site. Predictable and safe for new salvagers.

HUR-L4 Ship Graveyard.notes: Large capital ship debris. Reclaimer recommended for maximum yield.

MIC-L4 Ship Graveyard.notes: Quieter than L4 graveyards. Good for solo operators.

GrimHEX Surroundings.notes: High risk due to pirate activity. Highest wreck density in Stanton.

Pyro 4 Debris Fields.notes: Frequent derelicts and hostile traffic. Bring escort or keep runs short.

Pyro Gateway Fringe.notes: Transit corridor wrecks with moderate competition and manageable extraction windows.

Levski Drift Zone.notes: Consistent wreck pockets near Levski approaches, good for coordinated Vulture teams.

Nyx Outer Transit Wreckline.notes: Lower traffic route with periodic larger hull finds; best for patience-focused salvage loops.

tips: Always carry Arga or Lifeguard multi-tools for efficient hull scraping.
Sell RMC at Omega Pro (ARC-L5) for consistently high prices.
Use the Vulture's front arms to reach tight wreck sections the Reclaimer can't.
Component salvage from larger wrecks often yields more aUEC per run than hull scraping.
Check your cargo capacity before heading to a graveyard — leaving early wastes travel time.
